issue_context.title: dnf module doesn't work as expected in non-English environment
issue_context.body:
### Summary

The built-in package module doesn't work as expected in non-English environment, for example LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8.


### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

package

### Ansible Version

```console
[root@localhost ~]# ansible --version
ansible [core 2.11.0] 
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/root/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /usr/lib/python3.8/site-packages/ansible
  ansible collection location = /root/.ansible/collections:/usr/share/ansible/collections
  executable location = /bin/ansible
  python version = 3.8.6 (default, Jan 22 2021, 11:41:28) [GCC 8.4.1 20200928 (Red Hat 8.4.1-1)]
  jinja version = 2.10.3
  libyaml = True
```


### Configuration

```console
[root@localhost ~]# ansible-config dump --only-changed
[root@localhost ~]#
```


### OS / Environment

[root@localhost ~]# cat /etc/redhat-release 
Red Hat Enterprise Linux release 8.4 (Ootpa)

### Steps to Reproduce

Created a simple playbook as `nginx.yml` and run it.

```
# cat nginx.yml 
---
- hosts: localhost
  tasks:
    - name: Uninstall nginx-all-modules
      package:
        name:
          - nginx-all-modules
        state: absent
    - name: Uninstall nginx-mod*
      package:
        name:
          - nginx-mod*
        state: absent
```

### Expected Results

When LANG=C, it worked fine.

```
[root@localhost ~]# export LANG=C
[root@localhost ~]# ansible-playbook nginx.yml 
[WARNING]: provided hosts list is empty, only localhost is available. Note that the implicit localhost does not match 'all'

PLAY [localhost] *****************************************************************************************************************************************************

TASK [Gathering Facts] ***********************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [localhost]

TASK [Uninstall nginx-all-modules] ***********************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [localhost]

TASK [Uninstall nginx-mod*] ******************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [localhost]

PLAY RECAP ***********************************************************************************************************************************************************
localhost                  : ok=3    changed=0    unreachable=0    failed=0    skipped=0    rescued=0    ignored=0   

```


### Actual Results

On the other hand, when LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8 it failed.

```console
[root@localhost ~]# export LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8
[root@localhost ~]# ansible-playbook nginx.yml 
[WARNING]: provided hosts list is empty, only localhost is available. Note that the implicit localhost does not match 'all'

PLAY [localhost] *****************************************************************************************************************************************************

TASK [Gathering Facts] ***********************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [localhost]

TASK [Uninstall nginx-all-modules] ***********************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [localhost]

TASK [Uninstall nginx-mod*] ******************************************************************************************************************************************
fatal: [localhost]: FAILED! => {"changed": false, "failures": ["nginx-mod* - 一致した引数がありません: nginx-mod*"], "msg": "Failed to install some of the specified packages", "rc": 1, "results": []}

PLAY RECAP ***********************************************************************************************************************************************************
localhost                  : ok=2    changed=0    unreachable=0    failed=1    skipped=0    rescued=0    ignored=0   


```
```


### Code of Conduct

- [X] I agree to follow the Ansible Code of Conduct

Which actual package module is being run? `dnf`? See `-vvvv` output. Does this happen when running the specific package module directly?

[verboseoutput.txt](https://github.com/ansible/ansible/files/6663195/verboseoutput.txt)

I attached the output with `-vvvv`.  It uses `ansible.legacy.dnf` actually.

This is probably due to the underlying (yum/dnf/apt) module running a command line utility with LANG=C, which is needed to screen scrape the output messages or that we missed one and the i18n message does not match expectations.

Google translator says that `一致した引数がありません` means `No matching arguments` so it is likely an issue with these two methods:
https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/79a0799082c5a1d5c04ba4dd560475f97dea4ab5/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py#L388-L415

The `dnf` module uses dnf's Python API. As stated above we probably just need to set `LANG` in a way that matches expectations in those methods.

> Google translator says that `一致した引数がありません` means `No matching arguments` so it is likely an issue with these two methods:
> 
> https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/79a0799082c5a1d5c04ba4dd560475f97dea4ab5/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py#L388-L415
> 
> The `dnf` module uses dnf's Python API. As stated above we probably just need to set `LANG` in a way that matches expectations in those methods.

Excuse me for cutting in. Just FYI. You're right, I guess. See the log below.

```
[ssato@localhost dnf.git]$ pwd
/home/ssato/repos/public/github.com/rpm-software-management/dnf.git
[ssato@localhost dnf.git]$ msgunfmt /usr/share/locale/ja/LC_MESSAGES/dnf.mo | grep -B 2 '一致した引数がありません: '

msgid "No match for argument: %s"
msgstr "一致した引数がありません: %s"
[ssato@localhost dnf.git]$ grep -B 10 '一致した引数がありません: ' po/ja.po

#: dnf/base.py:2017 dnf/base.py:2036 dnf/base.py:2049 dnf/base.py:2076
#: dnf/base.py:2129 dnf/base.py:2137 dnf/base.py:2271 dnf/cli/cli.py:417
#: dnf/cli/commands/__init__.py:420 dnf/cli/commands/__init__.py:477
#: dnf/cli/commands/__init__.py:581 dnf/cli/commands/__init__.py:628
#: dnf/cli/commands/__init__.py:706 dnf/cli/commands/install.py:147
#: dnf/cli/commands/reinstall.py:70 dnf/cli/commands/reinstall.py:84
#: dnf/cli/commands/upgrade.py:105 dnf/cli/commands/upgrade.py:116
#, python-format
msgid "No match for argument: %s"
msgstr "一致した引数がありません: %s"
[ssato@localhost dnf.git]$
```

And the easiest way to fix this issue may be to call locale.setlocale(locale.LC_MESSAGES, 'en_US.UTF-8') (or C) before calling the DNF APIs as you said. (Not LANG, btw; LC_MESSAGES is better for this issue, I think.)

PS. Excuse me, I might be wrong and I should try grep-ing 'No match for argument' (not 'No match for argument: ') instead.

In this case to ensure packages not installed, the exception raised actually was PackagesNotInstalledError, I guess. So another better (IMHO) way to resolve this issue might be to try to catch that exception instead of tyring to processing the message after re-setting the locale.LC_MESSAGES in ansible's dnf module.

- PackagesNotInstalledError: https://github.com/rpm-software-management/dnf/blob/master/dnf/exceptions.py#L167
- The above exc. was raised from base.remove (base.Base._raise_package_not_installed_error), I guess: https://github.com/rpm-software-management/dnf/blob/master/dnf/base.py#L2208
- The needed change might be look like:

```
diff --git a/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py b/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py
index 0401d491cb..1ef23fb177 100644
--- a/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py
+++ b/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py
@@ -1174,6 +1174,8 @@ class DnfModule(YumDnf):
                                 failure_response['failures'].append('{0} - {1}'.format(pkg_spec, to_native(e)))
                             else:
                                 response['results'].append(handled_remove_error)
+                        except dnf.exceptions.PackagesNotInstalledError:
+                                response['results'].append("Ignore packages not installed: {0}".format(pkg_spec))
                         continue

                     installed_pkg = dnf.subject.Subject(pkg_spec).get_best_query(  
```

Locale `C/POSIX` is always guaranteed, why we normally use that, soon a `C.utf8` one will be prevalent, but `en_US.UTF-8'` is absent from too many systems to be usable. Sadly the `C` locale is ASCII and might cause issues with i18n package names.
something that might help fix this https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/75033

This POC fix should be enough to fix the issue, it does in my testing:
```diff
diff --git a/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py b/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py
index 0401d491cb6..db221db8930 100644
--- a/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py
+++ b/lib/ansible/modules/dnf.py
@@ -347,6 +347,11 @@ from ansible.module_utils.common.respawn import has_respawned, probe_interpreter
 from ansible.module_utils.yumdnf import YumDnf, yumdnf_argument_spec

 try:
+    user_lc_all, os.environ['LC_ALL'] = os.environ['LC_ALL'], 'C'
+    try:
+        import dnf
+    finally:
+        os.environ['LC_ALL'] = user_lc_all
     import dnf
     import dnf.cli
     import dnf.const
```
@sugitk would you mind testing the above PR to see if it fixes the issue?
